verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm selling legal advisory services, not a software platform, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a category error for this kind of offering. The evidence shows no first-party API. Probes for OpenAPI or Swagger paths all returned 404, and the only online tools mentioned are an investor-readiness checker and downloadable cap-table templates, neither of which is an API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
